summary: All 8 UI-facing acceptance criteria for the AION client-side login gate verified via named browser checks. Auth is explicitly a frontend-only sessionStorage gate per spec deviations, so no backend API surface exists for this feature and no backend test file was needed.

checks.criterion: Oturumsuz ziyaretçi korumalı ana sayfaya erişemez
checks.name: aion-login-redirect-unauthenticated
checks.evidence: goto('/') with no session -> URL redirected to /giris, login-screen visible

checks.criterion: Giriş paneli AION tasarımına uygun ve Türkçedir
checks.name: aion-login-panel-branding-turkish
checks.evidence: 1400x900: login-brand-mark='AION', login-card-kicker='Admin erişimi', login-card-heading='Tekrar hoş geldin.', field labels 'Kullanıcı adı'/'Şifre', submit button contains "AION'a giriş yap"

checks.name: aion-login-invalid-credentials-rejected
checks.evidence: Submitted tscheck-baduser/wrongpass123 -> stayed on /giris, login-feedback contains 'deneme hakkın kaldı', password input cleared to empty value

checks.criterion: Beş hatalı deneme geçici kilit uygular
checks.name: aion-login-lockout-after-five-failures
checks.evidence: 5 sequential wrong-password submits -> login-feedback contains '30 saniye', username/password inputs and submit button all disabled

checks.name: aion-login-valid-credentials-succeeds
checks.evidence: admin/AION#2026 submit -> URL became '/', assistant-home-screen visible

checks.name: aion-session-persists-on-refresh
checks.evidence: After login and page.reload(), URL stayed on '/' and assistant-home-screen remained visible (no redirect back to /giris)

checks.name: aion-sidebar-logout-clears-session
checks.evidence: sidebar-logout-button click -> redirected to /giris with login-screen visible; subsequent goto('/') also redirected back to /giris (session cleared)

checks.name: aion-login-panel-mobile-responsive
checks.evidence: 390x844: login-mobile-brand, username/password inputs, password toggle, submit button all visible; login-card boundingBox width <= 390; password toggle switched input type to 'text'
